en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a densely wooded forested valley with rocky hillsides on either side. In the distance, a tall structure (likely a tower or column) rises above the trees. Beneath the image there is bilingual text in Greek and French, and at the bottom a line indicating it is an edition of the Hellenic postal services. A round postal or publisher's seal appears in the lower left, and a small serial number (257) is printed at the bottom right.
